evidence_conflicts.description: The two speeds and a 10 min phrase do not specify order, duration per speed, or retained fraction; no sequence is inferred.

remaining_gaps: Matching Supporting Information is not present in the screened-pass input and was not used; XRD and UV–vis details referenced only there are not imported.
Monkey-grass botanical identity, mass basis, drying procedure and moisture are unreported.
Autoclave heating ramp, internal pressure, headspace, agitation and cooling profile are unreported.
The 4500 and 12000 rpm centrifugation speeds and 10 min wording do not establish separate per-speed durations, step order or retained fraction.
No full crystalline phase model, unit-cell parameters or atomic coordinates/CIF for the N-CQD product are reported in the main article.
No zeta-potential medium, TEM particle count, histogram bin definitions or assay iodide-source salt is identified.
No isolated dry product mass, stated yield denominator or final stored batch identifier.
Exact chemical group assignments and full XPS/O1s interpretation partly refer to Supporting Information and are not extended beyond the main article.
Table 1 tap- and lake-water iodide recovery values are available in the displayed source table; they are not yet structured as individual measurements in this draft.
